info.title: API Indonesia
info.description: API Indonesia gives one key to Indonesian public data from official sources: regions and postal codes, holidays, prayer times, BMKG earthquakes and weather, schools, hospitals, exchange rates, minimum wage, transport, trademarks, NIK and NPWP checks, QRIS and rupiah helpers.

get.description: Returns metadata for every registered dataset. This endpoint does not require an API key.
Returns snapshot and provenance metadata for one dataset.
Returns a list of all provinces in Indonesia.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Returns a single province by its region code.

get.summary: List regencies or cities in a province
get.description: Nested alias for listing regencies/cities by province code.
Returns a list of regencies and cities, optionally filtered by province.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Returns a single regency/city by its region code.

get.summary: List districts in a regency or city
get.description: Nested alias for listing districts by regency/city code.
Returns a list of districts, optionally filtered by regency/city.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Returns a single district by its region code.
Nested alias for listing villages and customary villages by district code.
Returns a list of villages complete with postal codes, optionally filtered by district.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Returns a single village by its region code.
Searches region names across all levels at once (province, regency, district, village). The level field indicates the region level of each result.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Returns a list of public holidays, sorted by date. Can be filtered by year and month.
Returns up to 10 upcoming public holidays, counted from today.
Returns a single public holiday by ID.
Returns the regencies/cities that have prayer time data. Use the regency_id from this response with the schedule endpoints.
Returns one day of prayer times for a given regency/city.

parameters.name: tanggal
parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

get.description: Returns a full month of prayer times for a given regency/city, sorted by date.
Returns a paginated list of schools with name/NPSN search plus region, level, status, and accreditation filters.

parameters.name: district_id
parameters.description: Filter by district ID. Indonesian alias: kecamatan_id.

parameters.name: district_code
parameters.description: Filter by district code. Indonesian alias: kecamatan_code.

parameters.name: jenis
parameters.description: School level: SD, SMP, SMA, SMK, or SLB.

parameters.name: accreditation
parameters.description: Filter by accreditation grade. Indonesian alias: akreditasi.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Exact NPSN or school-name prefix, minimum 2 characters.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 50, maximum 200.

get.description: Searches schools by name. Returns up to 50 results.
Returns a single school by NPSN, including province, regency/city, district, and village names.
Returns a paginated, filterable list of higher-education institutions, including province and regency/city names.

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Filter by province code. Legacy alias: provinsi_id.

parameters.name: regency
parameters.description: Filter by regency/city code. Legacy alias: kabupaten_id.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type: universitas, institut, politeknik, akademi, or sekolah_tinggi. Legacy alias: jenis.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group: PTN, PTS, PTA, or PTK. Legacy alias: kelompok.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 50, maximum 200.

get.description: Searches institutions by name or abbreviation. Returns up to 50 results.
Returns a single institution by ID, including province and regency/city names.
Compact list with name/code search and region, type, class, ownership, and BLU filters. Use the detail endpoint for service, staff, bed, and facility collections.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search partial hospital name or code.

parameters.name: province_id
parameters.description: Filter by province code. Legacy alias: provinsi_id.

parameters.name: regency_id
parameters.description: Filter by regency/city code. Legacy alias: kabupaten_id.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by raw SIRS hospital type or legacy type code. Alias: jenis.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Filter by hospital class. Alias: kelas.

parameters.name: blu
parameters.description: Filter BLU/BLUD status by SIRS label or boolean. Alias: blu_status/is_blu.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 50, maximum 200.

get.description: Searches hospitals by name/code with the same filters as the list endpoint. Returns up to 50 results.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name/code keyword, minimum 2 characters when code is absent.

get.description: Returns a full profile by internal ID or SIRS code, including available bed, service, staff, facility, provenance, and synchronization details.
Returns the 15 most recent earthquakes, newest first.
Returns the 15 most recent felt earthquakes (BMKG term for quakes reported felt by the public), complete with the MMI scale per area.
Returns earthquakes within a given date range, up to 100 records, newest first.
Returns a 3-day weather forecast for a single village. Choose between adm4 (village code) or kabupaten_id to fetch a representative forecast for the regency.

parameters.name: adm4
parameters.description: Village code from the Regions endpoint, e.g. 32.73.01.1001.

get.description: Searches for villages or cities that have weather forecast data by name. Returns a list of adm4 codes usable in the main endpoint.
Returns all currently active weather warnings. Can be filtered by province name.

parameters.name: provinsi
parameters.description: Filter by province name, e.g. Jawa Barat.

get.description: Returns paginated postal codes with explicit Kemendagri administrative codes. BPS code fields and filters are available for 96% of records (official SIG BPS 2025 bridge). A small number of newer villages have no BPS counterpart yet.

parameters.name: kecamatan_id
parameters.description: Filter by 6-digit Kemendagri district code, e.g. 327301.

parameters.name: bps_province_code
parameters.description: BPS province code. Official BPS code (SIG BPS 2025); filled for about 96% of records, some newer villages have no BPS counterpart yet.

parameters.name: bps_regency_code
parameters.description: BPS regency/city code. Official BPS code (SIG BPS 2025); filled for about 96% of records, some newer villages have no BPS counterpart yet.

parameters.name: bps_district_code
parameters.description: BPS district code. Official BPS code (SIG BPS 2025); filled for about 96% of records, some newer villages have no BPS counterpart yet.

parameters.name: bps_village_code
parameters.description: BPS village code. Official BPS code (SIG BPS 2025); filled for about 96% of records, some newer villages have no BPS counterpart yet.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.summary: Look up a region by postal or government code
get.description: Exact lookup by postal or Kemendagri code. At least one filter is required. Lookup by BPS code also works for the roughly 96% of records that have a BPS counterpart.

parameters.name: bps_province_code
parameters.description: BPS province code. Official BPS code (SIG BPS 2025); filled for about 96% of records, some newer villages have no BPS counterpart yet.

parameters.name: bps_regency_code
parameters.description: BPS regency/city code. Official BPS code (SIG BPS 2025); filled for about 96% of records, some newer villages have no BPS counterpart yet.

parameters.name: bps_district_code
parameters.description: BPS district code. Official BPS code (SIG BPS 2025); filled for about 96% of records, some newer villages have no BPS counterpart yet.

parameters.name: bps_village_code
parameters.description: BPS village code. Official BPS code (SIG BPS 2025); filled for about 96% of records, some newer villages have no BPS counterpart yet.

get.description: Searches postal codes by village name or postal code number.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword, minimum 2 characters. Can be a village name or postal code.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Returns a single postal code entry by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Postal code entry ID, e.g. kp_3273011001.

get.description: Returns the latest exchange rate for a given currency pair.
Returns historical exchange rates for a given date range.
Returns the complete list of 114 Al-Quran surahs, ordered by number.
Returns the metadata of a single surah by number (1–114).
Returns all 66 Bible books with chapter counts and testament classification (OT/NT).
Filter books by testament: PL (Old Testament) or PB (New Testament).

parameters.name: testament
parameters.description: The testament: PL for the Old Testament or PB for the New Testament.

get.description: Returns all verses in a chapter. Use book abbreviation (e.g. Gen, John, Ps) or full name.

parameters.name: bookAbbr
parameters.description: Book abbreviation or name, e.g. Kej, Yoh, Mzm.

get.description: Returns a single verse by book, chapter, and verse number.
Search for a word or phrase across all 31,104 Bible verses. Supports pagination via limit and offset.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Search KBBI dictionary by keyword. Supports pagination.
Returns all KBBI entries for a specific word (some words have multiple entries).

parameters.name: word
parameters.description: Word to look up, e.g. rumah.

get.description: Returns random words from KBBI. Useful for games or learning apps.
Returns all 61 vehicle plate codes, sorted by code.
Returns details for a single plate code.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Plate code, e.g. B, DK, L.

get.description: All provincial minimum wage records. Use query params to filter.

get.summary: Provincial minimum wage for all years
get.description: All UMP records for one province, sorted by latest year.

get.summary: Provincial minimum wage for one year
get.description: A single UMP record for a specific province and year.
Returns bank codes with valid account number lengths.

post.description: Checks 16-digit NIK format and extracts region/birth date codes. Not Dukcapil verification.
Checks 15-digit NPWP format. Not DJP verification.
Formats a number as Indonesian Rupiah string.
Decodes a QRIS EMVCo payload string.
Parses rupiah text, such as Rp1.500.000, into a number.
Spells out a rupiah amount in Indonesian words (terbilang).
Adds an amount to static QRIS and recalculates CRC.

get.description: Latest transaction rates for USD/EUR/SGD (default) or other currencies.
Daily rate history for one currency (max 366 days).
Searches halal supervisors (penyelia halal) registered with BPJPH by business or supervisor name.
Gets one halal supervisor record by its id_penyelia UUID.
Search registered medicine/traditional/cosmetic products.

get.summary: Retrieve a BPOM product by NIE
get.description: Get product by NIE (registration number).

get.summary: Convert a Gregorian date to Hijri
get.description: Convert one Gregorian date to Hijri.

parameters.name: tanggal
parameters.description: The Gregorian date to convert, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

get.description: Full date mapping for one Gregorian year (currently 2026).
Returns a list of legal mutual fund products registered with OJK. Supports pagination and name search.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip (for pagination).

get.description: Returns details of a single mutual fund product by ID.
Returns a list of legal investment apps registered with OJK. Supports pagination and name search.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip (for pagination).

get.description: Returns details of a single investment app by ID.

Returns a list of illegal investments flagged by OJK. Each entry may include aliases, addresses, phone numbers, emails, websites, entity type, activity types, and a description. Supports pagination and name search.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Search illegal investments by name (fuzzy match).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip (for pagination).

get.description: Returns details of a single illegal investment by ID.
Returns sunrise, sunset, solar noon, and day length for a given lat/lon and date. Handles polar night / midnight sun.

parameters.name: tanggal
parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: ISO timezone offset, e.g. +07:00. Defaults to +00:00.

get.description: Returns civil, nautical, and astronomical twilight boundaries for photography/observation.

parameters.name: tanggal
parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

get.description: Returns the moon phase (illumination, phase name, age, distance) for a given date.

parameters.name: tanggal
parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

get.description: Returns the next major moon phases (new/first quarter/full/last quarter), up to 12 ahead.

parameters.name: tanggal
parameters.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

get.description: Returns upcoming solar & lunar eclipses (approximation based on saros/draconic cycles). Dates & kinds are indicative.

parameters.name: tanggal
parameters.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

get.description: Returns registered trademarks matching a keyword. Search covers the mark-name column; use optional parameters to filter by owner, NICE class, or search within the owner column instead.

parameters.name: in
parameters.description: Set in=owner to search the keyword within the owner column instead of the mark name.

get.description: Returns details of a single trademark by application number. If the number only appears in the publication journal (not yet registered), the response still returns 200 with journal data plus a journal_events list.

Returns trademark applications published in the DJKI Berita Resmi Merek journal. Coverage is a rolling window of recent editions (roughly twice a month, last few months). Use it to monitor lookalike filings during the opposition window.
Lists the active region boundaries with their metadata.
Gets the source, license and GeoJSON URL of one region boundary.
GeoJSON application/geo+json; X-Data-* headers carry source, version, license and attribution. Illustrative geometry.

get.summary: List air quality readings for today
get.description: Lists the air quality readings cached today for Indonesian cities. The list may be empty early in the day.

get.summary: Latest air quality for a city
get.description: Gets the latest air quality reading for a city by part of its name. Returns 404 when the city has no reading.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The city name or part of it, for example Jakarta.

get.description: Returns a summary of every series (consumer/producer level x national/province region): commodity count, row count, and the available month range.
Returns monthly average food prices, filterable by level, region, commodity, province, and month range. Prices are integers in rupiah; "-" in the source becomes null.

parameters.name: komoditas
parameters.description: Filter by commodity name, e.g. beras premium (partial match).

parameters.name: provinsi
parameters.description: Filter by province name or code, e.g. aceh or 11.

get.description: Strategic commodity price-anomaly indices (QIPA, AIPA, IFPA) with status Alert (Low/High Price) or Normal. From National Food Agency monthly releases (check the latest date in the response); useful to flag abnormal price spikes or drops.

parameters.name: komoditas
parameters.description: Filter by commodity name, e.g. beras premium.

get.description: Returns the 240 Transjakarta routes. - Short and long names - Service description (BRT, integrated public transport, Mikrotrans, Transjabodetabek, tour bus) - GTFS route type - Corporate colour with its text colour - The number of unique halte the route serves, counted across both directions, not the number of rows.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive route-name search, e.g. blok (23 routes).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: One route in full. - The fares that apply to it (from fare_rules) - Its departure headways (per trip) - The halte list of both directions: "ke" for direction_id 0 and "kembali" for direction_id 1, each ordered by ascending stop_sequence - An unknown route answers 404 NOT_FOUND - The official release carries no street geometry, so per-segment travel distances are not available here.
Returns the 8,091 Transjakarta halte with code, name, coordinates, and GTFS stop type. The q filter partially matches name, code, or halte ID.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search a halte by name, code, or ID, e.g. monas or B02475P.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Finds the halte around a coordinate, nearest first, with the distance in metres (distance_m). - A bounding box is applied first and the exact great-circle distance second, so a 5 km radius stays cheap - Radius defaults to 1,000 metres (maximum 5,000) and limit to 20 (maximum 100) - A missing or non-numeric lat/lng, a radius outside 1-5,000, or a limit outside 1-100 answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the reference point, -90 to 90, e.g. -6.172531.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the reference point, -180 to 180, e.g. 106.82315.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, 1 to 5,000. Defaults to 1,000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum halte returned, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

get.description: One halte plus the routes that call there, one row per route and direction pair (direction_id). A halte served in both directions appears twice, and a tourist halte can be served by several routes. An unknown halte answers 404 NOT_FOUND.

The six GTFS fares with their rupiah prices. - FP: Rp3,500, the flat Transjakarta fare - GR: Rp0, free on selected routes - PP: Rp20,000, plus PP2/PP3 for airport services - How many transfers are allowed (null means the fare covers a single journey) - This endpoint does not paginate, so meta carries the attribution only.

Departure frequencies from GTFS frequencies.txt. - One row per trip serving that route, with the operating window and the headway in seconds (900 seconds means a bus every 15 minutes) - The route filter narrows the result to one route; a route without frequency rows answers an empty list, not a 404 - Times are returned as the source "HH:MM:SS" strings, so night services can exceed 24:00:00.

parameters.name: rute
parameters.description: Route ID to narrow the result, e.g. 10A.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: POI list ordered by name. - The q filter matches the START of the name, case-insensitively (q=masjid matches "Masjid Istiqlal", q=istiqlal does not) - category takes a key from /api/v1/poi/categories - locality (alias kota) matches the city/regency exactly as written in the Overture address, e.g. "Jakarta Selatan" or "Surabaya" - Filters can be combined - per_page is capped at 100 and the offset at 5,000.

parameters.name: locality
parameters.description: City/regency as in the Overture address (alias: kota), e.g. Jakarta Pusat.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: POI around a coordinate, nearest first, with the distance in metres (distance_m). - Optionally filtered by category and minimum confidence (min_confidence) - Radius defaults to 1,000 metres (maximum 5,000) and limit to 20 (maximum 100) - A missing or non-numeric lat/lon, a radius outside 1-5,000, a limit outside 1-100, or a min_confidence outside 0-1 answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR - lng is accepted as an alias for lon.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the reference point, e.g. -6.1753924.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude of the reference point, e.g. 106.8271528.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in metres, 1 to 5,000. Defaults to 1,000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum POI returned, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

get.description: Every Overture category present in the Indonesian data (1,250 categories), most POI first, with basic_category, taxonomy hierarchy and POI count. The q filter partially matches the category key.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the category key, e.g. restaurant.

get.description: One POI by its Overture ID (GERS ID, stable across releases). An unknown ID answers 404 NOT_FOUND.

Details for one IP address. - Country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), continent code, region, city, latitude/longitude - The ASN with its organisation name, and the DB-IP range the address falls in - IPv6 can be written directly in the path; IPv4-mapped addresses (::ffff:a.b.c.d) are looked up as IPv4 - An invalid address answers 400 and an address with no matching range answers 404; neither is charged.

get.summary: Look up the caller IP address
get.description: Same as /ip/{ip}, for the address that called the API (the CF-Connecting-IP header). The answer still comes from the DB-IP tables, not from Cloudflare's own geolocation. Never edge-cached. On the RapidAPI surface the caller address is the RapidAPI gateway, so this endpoint answers 400 UNSUPPORTED there; use /ip/{ip}.

post.description: Up to 100 addresses in one call, answered in input order. - An invalid or uncovered address gets a per-item error object instead of failing the whole call - Priced per CALL, not per IP: 100 credits for 1 to 100 addresses (1 credit per IP on a full batch) - For fewer than 50 addresses, /ip/{ip} (2 credits per call) is cheaper - A body with no valid address answers 400 and is not charged.

get.description: Searches the 1,644 entities with an Indonesian legal or headquarters address (golden copy snapshot of 1 November 2026). - q matches the legal name and other/transliterated names through a full-text index (word prefixes) - The provinsi filter applies to both the legal and headquarters address - Some GLEIF records still use retired island codes (for example ID-JW for Java) and those are not rolled up into provinces.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words from the entity name, e.g. pertamina.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Entity status: ACTIVE, INACTIVE or NULL.

parameters.name: registration_status
parameters.description: LEI registration status, e.g. ISSUED or LAPSED.

parameters.name: kota
parameters.description: Part of the city on the legal or headquarters address, e.g. surabaya. City spelling follows GLEIF records ("Jakarta Selatan" or "SOUTH JAKARTA").

parameters.name: provinsi
parameters.description: ISO 3166-2 code (ID-JK) or province name (DKI Jakarta, Jawa Timur).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: One entity in full. - Legal and headquarters addresses - Registration number (registration_authority.id from the GLEIF authority list + entity_id) - Registration status and managing LOU - direct_parent and ultimate_parent (null when no relationship record exists) - An LEI with the wrong shape or an invalid ISO 17442 checksum answers 400 INVALID_LEI; a valid LEI outside the dataset answers 404.

get.summary: List child entities of an LEI
get.description: Entities that report this LEI as their direct parent (type=direct, the default), ultimate parent (type=ultimate), or either (type=all). For a parent abroad, only the children held in this dataset (entities with an Indonesian address) are listed.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Returns the 252 countries and territories in GeoNames countryInfo, ordered by name: ISO2, ISO3, numeric code, capital, continent, area, population, currency, calling code (without +), languages, TLD, postal code format and neighbours.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial country or capital name, or an exact ISO2/ISO3 code.

parameters.name: continent
parameters.description: Continent filter: AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 50, maximum 300 (every country in one page).

get.description: One country by ISO2 or ISO3 code (case-insensitive), with its time zones and the number of its cities in the cities5000 data. An unknown code answers 404 NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: ISO2 or ISO3 code, e.g. ID or IDN.

get.description: Cities from GeoNames cities5000, largest population first. q matches the PREFIX of the name or ASCII name, case-insensitively ("sao" finds São Paulo); translated names (e.g. Indonesian names for foreign cities) are not available yet.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO2 country code, e.g. ID (485 cities).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Cities around a coordinate, nearest first, with the great-circle distance in kilometres (distance_km). Radius defaults to 50 km (maximum 500) and limit to 20 (maximum 100). Searches across the 180° meridian are handled.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in km, maximum 500. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of cities, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

get.description: One city by geonameid, with the country name, elevation, DEM, GeoNames modification date and its time zone offsets. An unknown id answers 404 NOT_FOUND.

All 418 time zones in GeoNames timeZones.txt (or one country with country), with the GMT offset on 1 January, the DST offset on 1 July of the same year (offset_year) and the raw offset without DST, in hours.

One IANA time zone with the GeoNames offsets and the CURRENT local time, computed per request from the runtime IANA data (not cached): local_time, utc_offset and is_dst. The id may contain slashes (Asia/Jakarta) and is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: IANA time zone id, e.g. Asia/Jakarta.

get.description: Returns the 77 toll roads in the BPJT list with operator (BUJT), status (operasi or operasi sebagian), total and operating length, provinces, operating decree date, investment value when available, gate count, BPJT road code, type (intercity/urban) and the PSN flag. Ordered by name.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial search on road name or operator, e.g. cikampek.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status filter: operasi or operasi sebagian.

parameters.name: provinsi
parameters.description: 2-digit Kemendagri province code, e.g. 32. Any other format answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: One toll road with its history (sejarah: operating decree and PPJT from BPJT, plus the Wikipedia opening date when available), its sources, every toll gate on the road and the BPJT tariffs for it. An unknown road answers 404 NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Road ID from GET /tol/ruas, e.g. kanci-pejagan.

get.description: Returns the 558 toll gates with coordinates, toll road, province, regency/city, operator and validation status. Filters can be combined.

parameters.name: validasi
parameters.description: Terverifikasi or osm. Any other value answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Finds the toll gates around a coordinate, nearest first, with the distance in metres (distance_m). Radius defaults to 10,000 metres (maximum 50,000) and limit to 10 (maximum 50); a missing or non-numeric lat/lng, a radius outside 1-50,000 or a limit outside 1-50 answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the reference point, e.g. -6.2.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the reference point, e.g. 106.8.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in metres, 1 to 50,000. Defaults to 10,000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum gates returned, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

get.description: One gate with its validation details: number of merged OSM points, distance to the OSM toll carriageway (jarak_ke_tol_m), validation notes (checks passed and confirming sources) and the OSM element IDs. An unknown gate answers 404 NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Gate ID from GET /tol/gerbang, e.g. ciawi-jakarta-bogor-ciawi.

get.description: Returns the 1,485 tariff rows from the BPJT "Data Tarif Jalan Tol" sheet: origin, destination and the rupiah tariff for classes I, II-III and IV-V (classes II and III, and IV and V, share a tariff as in the source). Tariffs change by ministerial decree, so check BPJT for adjustments after the snapshot date.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the road name as written in the tariff sheet.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Returns the 440 airports with ICAO/IATA codes, region, coordinates, elevation, size, scheduled service, international status and validation status. Filters can be combined.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial search on airport or regency/city name, or an exact ICAO/IATA code, e.g. supadio or PNK.

parameters.name: provinsi
parameters.description: 2-digit Kemendagri province code, e.g. 61. Any other format answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

parameters.name: internasional
parameters.description: True for the 36 international airports (KM 37 Tahun 2025), false for the rest.

parameters.name: jenis
parameters.description: Airport size: besar, sedang or kecil.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Finds airports around a coordinate, nearest first, with the distance in metres (distance_m). Radius defaults to 50,000 metres (maximum 300,000) and limit to 5 (maximum 50); invalid parameters answer 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the reference point, e.g. -0.03.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the reference point, e.g. 109.33.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in metres, 1 to 300,000. Defaults to 50,000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum airports returned, 1 to 50. Defaults to 5.

get.description: One airport by ICAO code, IATA code or id, with its runways (direction, length, width, surface), operator when available, Wikidata ID, validation notes (distances between sources and to the official position) and coordinate source. An unknown code answers 404 NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: kode
parameters.description: ICAO code (WIOO), IATA code (PNK) or id (wioo).

get.description: Returns the 1,082 sea and ferry ports with hierarchy or class, region, UN/LOCODE, coordinates when validated and validation status. Filters can be combined.

parameters.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Finds ports with coordinates around a coordinate, nearest first, with the distance in metres (distance_m). Radius defaults to 25,000 metres (maximum 200,000) and limit to 10 (maximum 50); ports without coordinates are not included. Invalid parameters answer 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the reference point, e.g. -5.93.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the reference point, e.g. 105.99.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in metres, 1 to 200,000. Defaults to 25,000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum ports returned, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

get.description: One port by id or UN/LOCODE, with its 2017/2027/2037 hierarchy, World Port Index details when available, validation notes, coordinate source and legal basis. An unknown id answers 404 NOT_FOUND.
Returns the 614 bus terminals with type (A or null), managing BPTD for type A, region, coordinates when validated and validation status. Filters can be combined.

parameters.name: q

parameters.name: koordinat

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the reference point, e.g. -6.2125.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the reference point, e.g. 106.9525.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in metres, 1 to 100,000. Defaults to 10,000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum terminals returned, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

get.description: One terminal with address (when available), Wikidata ID, validation notes, coordinate source and legal basis. An unknown terminal answers 404 NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Terminal ID from the list endpoint, e.g. terminal-leuwipanjang-kota-bandung.

get.description: Returns the 1,129 stations with code, type, operator, Daop/Divre, status, region, coordinates and validation status. The jenis filter also matches services, so jenis=krl includes heavy-rail stations served by KRL.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial station-name search or an exact station code, e.g. gambir or GMR.

parameters.name: jenis
parameters.description: Kereta_api, krl, mrt, lrt, kereta_cepat or kereta_bandara.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

Radius defaults to 5,000 metres (maximum 100,000) and limit to 10 (maximum 50). Invalid parameters answer 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the reference point, e.g. -6.1767.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the reference point, e.g. 106.8306.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in metres, 1 to 100,000. Defaults to 5,000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum stations returned, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: jenis
parameters.description: Filter by type or service, e.g. krl.

parameters.name: status

get.description: One station by KAI station code or ID, with its service list, elevation, Wikidata ID, validation notes and coordinate source. When a code is shared by more than one row, the active station wins. An unknown code answers 404 NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: kode
parameters.description: KAI station code or ID, e.g. GMR.

get.summary: List regency or city minimum wages (UMK)
get.description: Returns regency and city minimum wages for the requested year, defaulting to the latest year in the dataset. Province filter, name search and value sort can be combined; the result count is in meta.total.

parameters.name: tahun
parameters.description: Year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the latest year available.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial search on the regency/city name, e.g. bekasi.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Umk_asc or umk_desc to sort by value; the default order is province then regency/city.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.summary: Retrieve one regency or city minimum wage
get.description: Returns the latest wage for one regency/city code, with the validation note and the history of earlier years (empty when only one year exists). A region that only uses the provincial UMP answers 404.
Returns the 99 BTKI chapters with their section, Indonesian and English descriptions and the number of tariff lines per chapter. Useful for building navigation before filtering codes.

Returns eight-digit HS codes with their description, heading, chapter and MFN duty. q accepts a 2 to 8 digit code (dots ignored) or words from the description; the bab and pos filters can be combined.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: An HS code (2 to 8 digits, dots ignored) or words from the description, e.g. 0901 or kopi.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Returns one HS code with its MFN duty, the validation note and its chapter detail. The code may be written with dots (8517.13.00) or without; an unknown code answers 404.

Returns electricity tariffs in force on a date (default today, WIB), one row per class and power limit. The golongan filter matches partially; kategori filters household, business, industrial or government classes.

parameters.name: tanggal
parameters.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today (WIB).

parameters.name: golongan
parameters.description: Tariff class, partial match, e.g. R-1.

parameters.name: kategori
parameters.description: Rumah tangga, bisnis, industri or pemerintah.

get.summary: Electricity tariff history for one class
get.description: Returns every tariff period for one class, ordered by class, power limit and period start. The golongan parameter is required; an unknown class answers 404.

parameters.name: golongan
parameters.description: Tariff class, partial match, e.g. R-1. Required.

get.description: Returns subsidised and assigned fuel prices in force on a date (default today, WIB), ordered by product, with the unit, the selling area and the legal basis.

parameters.name: tanggal
parameters.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today (WIB).

get.description: Returns every fuel price period, or a single product when produk is given (partial match, e.g. pertalite), ordered by product then start date.

parameters.name: produk
parameters.description: Product name, partial match, e.g. pertalite.

get.description: Returns the six categories with their facility counts and subcategory breakdown. Useful for building a filter menu before calling the list endpoint.

Returns facilities matching the filters, ordered by name. At least one of kategori, provinsi, kabupaten or q is required; without a filter the answer is 400, so the whole table is never pulled at once.

parameters.description: Puskesmas, spbu, polisi, pemadam_kebakaran, kantor_pos or ibadah.

parameters.description: Subcategory within the category, e.g. rawat_inap or pertashop.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial search on the facility name, e.g. istiqlal.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to 1; a page past the offset ceiling answers 400 PAGINATION_LIMIT.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

get.description: Finds facilities around a coordinate, nearest first, with the distance in metres (distance_m). Radius defaults to 2,000 metres (maximum 50,000) and limit to 10 (maximum 50). Facilities without coordinates are not returned.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the reference point, e.g. -6.1702.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the reference point, e.g. 106.8311.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in metres, 1 to 50,000. Defaults to 2,000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum facilities returned, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: kategori
parameters.description: Restrict to one category, e.g. spbu.

parameters.name: subkategori
